summary: Okanogan National Forest L-5 cab on Setting Sun Mountain: built 1932 or 1933, removed or destroyed 1953. Willhite found a stovepipe, phone line and anchors there in 2022.

facts.status_note: L-5 cab removed or destroyed in 1953; WillhiteWeb found a stovepipe, phone line and anchors at the site on a 2022 visit

visit.trail_note: Hiking distance 2 miles one-way with 1,700 feet of elevation gain, per WillhiteWeb; the terrain is open and easy to navigate

events.note: Register and Rex's page give 1932; WillhiteWeb dates the L-5 cab to 1933
Register says removed; Rex's page and WillhiteWeb say destroyed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Rex's page date the L-5 cab to 1932; WillhiteWeb says it was built in 1933 and cites two Wenatchee Daily World articles. The story gives both dates
Register says removed in 1953; Rex's page and WillhiteWeb say destroyed in 1953

notes_for_editor: Built year (1932 vs 1933) is unresolved. Staffing rests on WillhiteWeb's undated remark about the unoccupied lookout. No source states access rules for the route, so no access fact is recorded. Only WillhiteWeb describes the site today, from a 2022 visit.
